_comment: Activities the avatar can do. Each activity has options; each option has a duration in avatar hours (or "slider" for sleep), mety (youth MET: energy per avatar hour = BMR / 24 x mety, Milestone 10), effects per avatar hour on GameState values (none for now), kcal_per_hour (calories spent, a record only), activity_intensity ("moderate_vigorous" counts toward the 60 minutes), a background colour and an animation name. Effects and calories only count for the time actually done. Options marked "placeholder": true use temporary numbers; kcal_per_hour and activity_intensity have their own status and owner (MILESTONE_4.md).

sleep.name: Sleep

mety.comment: Youth MET while asleep (v1 Step 3). Energy per avatar hour = BMR / 24 x METy.

sleep.comment: Duration comes from the sleep slider (config.json: sleep_activity, time.max_sleep_hours). No per-hour effect: when the sleep ends, its hours give the sleep score, and the sleep measure is worked out from it (config.json: health.debt_max).

cardio.name: Cardio

activity_intensity.comment: Until the MET values from the Youth Compendium are in.

cardio.comment: Cardio spends more calories than muscle strength. Fitness changes once per avatar day from the activity score (config.json: health).

strength.name: Muscle strength

mety.comment: Strength or calisthenics, Youth Compendium (v1 Step 3).

activity_intensity.comment: Until the MET values from the Youth Compendium are in.

strength.comment: Muscle changes once per avatar day from the strength score (config.json: health). There is no fatigue system.

eat.name: Eat
eat._comment: Milestone 10, Task 3. The food values of each option are in data/foods.json (same id). A meal takes avatar time (decision 2, user, 25 Oct 2026; the duration is a placeholder); its kcal and its effect on hunger count when it ends, in proportion to the time eaten (Stop = part of a meal).

mety.comment: Eating while sitting. Not in v1.
Eating while sitting. Not in v1.

entertainment.name: Entertainment

mety.comment: Screens (watching TV 1.3, Youth Compendium; v1 Step 3). Screens and football replace this option in Task 4.

entertainment.comment: One option until the real entertainment menu is decided. It is logged as screen time and counts in the screens habit score; mood changes once per avatar day.
